'''Kenloo's Market''' was located in [[Grid 19]] of the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], it burned down along with an entire city block. The fire was officially attributed to arson.
